title: DiffWAM: A Fast and Efficient Navigation World Action Model
abstract: arXiv:2609.39763v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Pretrained video foundation models encode rich semantic and spatiotemporal priors for embodied navigation, yet converting these priors into UAV motion typically requires expensive future-video synthesis and geometric reconstruction. We investigate whether the motion implicit in future visual prediction can instead be recovered directly from the predictive representations of a frozen video model. To this end, we present DiffWAM, a geometry-conditioned navigation world-action model that directly transforms multi-level predictive features into continuous camera trajectories. Its Grid-Motion module preserves spatial-temporal motion associations, while Latent2Pose grounds them with first-frame geometry to recover metrically meaningful 3D motion. translated_title: DiffWAM：一种快速高效的导航世界动作模型
translated_abstract: 预训练视频基础模型为具身导航编码了丰富的语义与时空先验，然而将这些先验转化为无人机运动通常需要昂贵的未来视频合成与几何重建。我们研究了能否从冻结视频模型的预测表征中直接恢复隐含于未来视觉预测中的运动。为此，我们提出了DiffWAM，一种几何条件化的导航世界-动作模型，它将多层级预测特征直接转换为连续的相机轨迹。其Grid-Motion（网格-运动）模块保留了时空运动关联，而Latent2Pose模块利用首帧几何信息对其进行接地约束，从而恢复具有度量意义的3D运动。完整的视频推演与几何重建仅在离线监督阶段需要，从而在部署时无需未来视频解码与多帧重建。我们进一步引入（摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 提出DiffWAM，一种几何条件化的导航世界动作模型，能从冻结视频模型的预测表征中直接恢复连续相机轨迹，部署时无需未来视频解码与几何重建，实现快速高效的无人机导航。
en_tdlr: DiffWAM is a geometry-conditioned navigation world-action model that directly converts predictive features from a frozen video foundation model into continuous camera trajectories, eliminating future-video decoding and geometric reconstruction at deployment for fast and efficient UAV navigation.
